description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [50% Critical (25s)] to all allies, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Father Mode I (Sazh)] and [Machinst/Support Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Father Mode I (Sazh)
description.text: Machinst and Support abilities trigger 1 additional time, cast speed x2.00 for Machinst and Support abilities, grants [Dual Crimson Bravery 60% Critical]/[Dual Crimson Bravery 80% Critical]/[Dual Crimson Bravery 100% Critical] after using 1/2/3+ Machinst or Support abilities, grants [Deadly Strikes +20% 1] and [Quick Cast 1] to allies with any Attach Fire after using Machinist or Support abilities
